Scene:
别的人给了神农一个灵芝。这个植物可以让神农更好。比方说，他会觉得更健康。吃灵芝以后，他可以再走。现在他觉得更好。最后，神农找到了很多植物，他可以用对药。这些植物让神农很高兴。神农想跟很多人分享他的新药。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 别的人给了神农一个灵芝：另外一个人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 这个植物可以让神农更好：身体更好
- 比方说，他会觉得更健康：比方说is used to express “for example”, delete it
- 吃灵芝以后，他可以再走：吃了，了completed; 又可以走了

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 别的人给了神农一个灵芝：别人给了神农一个灵芝，别人 refers to other people as a group; 别的 is used before a noun, so 别的人 is not the natural subject form here. [teacher rule: bieren]
Run 2: 别的人：一个人，别的人 refers to people other than an already identified person or group; since no such contrast has been introduced here, use an indefinite person for this first appearance. [teacher rule: bieren]
Run 3: 别的人：别人，Use this word for “other people” when no specific contrast with another group has been established. [teacher rule: bieren]

output.reason: All runs flag “别的人,” but their replacements do not consistently preserve the intended meaning of “另外一个人” in the teacher’s correction.
